meta.title: Dwell Developers — Boutique real estate developer
meta.description: Boutique real estate developer in Uruguay. High-quality residential projects, managed with rigor and transparency for buyers and investors.

hero.title: We develop places truly worth living in.
hero.text: For over a decade we have been creating high-quality residential neighborhoods and buildings, with the rigor and transparency our buyers and investors expect.

featured.title: Your weekend retreat, every day.
featured.text: Three low-rise buildings joined by a park, next to a linear park in Carrasco. 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments overlooking the park, the woods or the sea, with twelve amenities designed for living close to nature.

intro.title: We choose few projects and develop them with full dedication.
intro.text: We identify investment opportunities in a professional and creative way, and manage every development with care for design, timelines and numbers. The result: neighborhoods and buildings that gain value over time, and communities that choose to stay.

services.title: One team, from opportunity to delivery

items.title: Residential development
items.text: We create high-quality, secure residential buildings and neighborhoods, supporting every buyer throughout the process.

items.title: Commercial development
items.text: We design spaces to work and enjoy, with a firm commitment to their surroundings and the communities around them.

items.title: Investment management
items.text: We structure and manage real estate trusts with clear information, timelines met and measurable results.

why.title: Quality is not a detail. It is the starting point.

items.title: Uncompromising quality
items.text: Thoughtful design and fine materials, in harmony with the architecture of each setting.

items.title: Considered amenities
items.text: Shared spaces that add to daily life: green, recreational and for work.

items.title: Green surroundings
items.text: Every project starts from a simple idea: living in harmony with nature.

items.title: Community
items.text: We design so neighbors can meet and community life grows stronger.

investors.title: Invest with a team that delivers on its promises.
investors.text: Nuevocentro Towers was República AFAP's first real estate investment project. At Oxo Parques, the cost deviation was under 4%. We manage every trust with the same discipline.

about.title: Over ten years developing with rigor and care.
about.text: We identify investment opportunities in a professional and creative way. We manage investments in real estate developments, ensuring results and earning our clients' trust.
story: Dwell was born from a conviction: the best projects are built with time, attention to detail and teams that know every number of the job.
That is why we choose few developments and get involved in every stage: sourcing the opportunity, structuring the financing, designing with top-tier studios, building and delivering.

team.name: Ing. Francisco Olaizola
bio: Civil engineer from Universidad de Montevideo, with studies at the University of Pittsburgh (USA) and a postgraduate degree from the University of Catalonia.
Extensive experience in construction and development projects. Co-founder of Dwell Developers, dedicated to raising and managing investments in real estate.

team.name: Ing. Elbio Olaizola
bio: Businessman and director of engineering and construction companies. Projects under his management include Carrasco International Airport, the Executive Tower of the Presidency, World Trade Center IV and Nuevocentro Shopping.
With broad real estate experience, he took part in the Nuevocentro Towers trust, Oxo Parques and Zen Pueblo Jardín.
